test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence contains an error. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error.

He is the better - looking hero in the entire film industry.

options.text: He is the best - looking hero in the entire film industry.
He is the good - looking hero than the entire film industry.
He is the best - looking hero more than the entire film industry.
He is the good - looking hero in the entire film industry.

solution:
The correct answer is: He is the best - looking hero in the entire film industry .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence incorrectly uses the comparative adjective 'better' instead of the superlative adjective 'best'.
 
• In English grammar, when comparing one item with all others in its category, the superlative form is used.
 
• The word 'entire' indicates that we are talking about the whole film industry, hence the superlative form 'best' should be used.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence is 'He is the best - looking hero in the entire film industry.'.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
